selection.rule: Lowest two SHA256(seed:identity) per hash-state x license-label cell; no replacement after failures

decisions: Keep upstream content identity, original Git/blob identity, decoded text identity and consumed-text SHA256 separate; do not disable source-byte checks or accept arbitrary mismatches.
Transformation equivalence is technical provenance, not semantic correctness or source-use approval.
License labels are screening metadata. Preserve pinned notices; review scope and third-party material before acceptance.
A wider sample must account for repository concentration; do not extrapolate file proportions from two row groups.
remaining: Explanations are verified for 12 diagnostic files only, not all 7084 mismatches.
Two selected files lack complete ancestor-notice context because their tree response exceeded the bound.
Dataset use decisions, original attribution handling, semantic quality, benchmark exclusions and family/near-duplicate separation remain open.
next: Cost a broader repository-stratified sample with a fixed byte cap and failed selections retained; use current pin and keep the frozen Stack-Edu audit intact.
